content:
I tested rolling 6 dice 34 times, which is 204 rolls total. Theoretically, that gives about 357 bits of entropy, which in practice comes out to 256. 

I tried it out, as you can see on the side, using the new firmware  on the Coldcard Q with the update. It generates the exact same seed as the app. 

I've never used these seed phrases for anything real, they're just for testing, so feel free to take them—there are plenty of them anyway.

So we can say that as a signing device, the Coldcard Q basically works like a standard. The 204 dice rolls provide plenty of entropy, and basically you don't need any manufacturer's device or any digital black box. Just a few dice and 20 minutes.
